name: Carnival Row
description: In a mystical and dark city filled with humans, fairies and other creatures, a police detective investigates a series of gruesome murders leveled against the fairy population. During his investigation, the detective becomes the prime suspect and must find the real killer to clear his name.

videos.title: Official Prologue - Philo's Story
videos.overview: Philo tells the story of his life before the war and what or who he left behind.

videos.title: Official Prologue - Vignette's Story
videos.overview: Vignette tells the story of her life before the war and what or who brought her to the Row.

videos.title: From Page to Screen: Imagining a New World
videos.overview: Carnival Row creator, Travis Beacham, discusses his journey bringing the series to life.

videos.title: Some Dark God Wakes
videos.overview: Rycroft “Philo” Philostrate investigates “Unseelie Jack”, a mysterious assailant with a grudge against the fae. Vignette Stonemoss barely escapes Tirnanoc with her life and arrives in The Burgue looking for a fresh start. Imogen Spurnrose meets her new neighbor. In Parliament, the fight over the critch heats up.

videos.title: Aisling
videos.overview: Philo investigates the murder of a mysterious fae. Tourmaline introduces Vignette to a new group of faeries. Imogen tries to have Agreus removed from the neighborhood. Jonah disappears.

videos.title: Kingdoms of the Moon
videos.overview: Once, as a Burguish soldier, Philo was tasked with protecting a faerish mimasery. While The Pact bears down on them, Philo meets Vignette and finds love in the most unlikely of places.

videos.title: The Joining of Unlike Things
videos.overview: Philo investigates the murder of his childhood headmaster. Vignette ingratiates herself into the Black Raven. Imogen hatches a plan to help her brother. Breakspear goes on the offensive with Longerbane.

videos.title: Grieve No More
videos.overview: Philo consults a Haruspex in an effort to find clues about the killer. Vignette grows closer with her newfound family. Upon Jonah’s return home, his parents cast a more watchful eye over him as a new player makes a splash in Parliament. Imogen brings Agreus into her circle.

videos.title: Unaccompanied Fae
videos.overview: The pieces of the puzzle start to come together for Philo. Vignette finds home in a place she never expected. Jonah sneaks off to see someone he shouldn’t. Imogen and Agreus step out together in public.

videos.title: The World to Come
videos.overview: Because he withheld evidence from his fellow detectives, Philo is accused of being the man behind the string of murders and is thrown in jail. There, he finds some unexpected help from Vignette. Elsewhere, Ezra takes exception to Imogen’s relationship with Agreus. Sophie offers Jonah a deal.

videos.title: The Gloaming
videos.overview: As tensions rise on Carnival Row, Philo must confront both darkness incarnate and the evil that controls it. Vignette gleans the true nature of The Burgue. Imogen lets her feelings for Agreus go unbridled. Breakspear's secrets catch up to him.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: Lovers Philo and Vignette risk their lives to help the oppressed Faefolk of Carnival Row.

videos.title: New Dawn
videos.overview: When Philo plots to challenge Jonah's hereditary claim to the Chancellorship, Vignette intervenes.

videos.title: The Martyr's Hand
videos.overview: While Philo investigates the murders of the Black Raven’s leaders, Vignette plots revenge.

videos.title: An Unkindness of Ravens
videos.overview: Philo races to stop Vignette’s revenge before the Black Raven spark even worse violence.

videos.title: Reckoning
videos.overview: Philo plots Vignette’s rescue with an unlikely ally.  Jonah discovers Sophie’s treachery.  The murderer strikes again.

videos.title: Original Sins
videos.overview: A painful truth haunts Philo as Carnival Row faces reprisals for the horrific events at Bleakness Keep.

videos.title: Kindred
videos.overview: Torn between his Human and Fae sides, Philo makes a choice.

videos.title: Facta Non Verba
videos.overview: Reeling from the consequences of his choices, Philo rejects defining himself as either Human or Fae.

videos.title: Battle Lines
videos.overview: Justice later through peace, or now through blood?

videos.title: Carnival Row
videos.overview: The epic finale of “Carnival Row.”

awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 11 nominations total
